Bid Summary.value: Dallas Independent School District is procuring Student and Staff Computing Devices under bid JA-207652 / 168884 / 00004079100, with target quantities spread over the life of the contract for student Chromebooks, student Windows laptops, student tablets, staff laptops, staff desktops, and display monitors. The bid is due July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST after Addendum 2 changed the original June 27, 2024 deadline, and the pre-bid meeting was held June 10, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST via TEAMS, with attendance highly encouraged but not stated as mandatory. Submission is preferred electronically through the iSupplier portal, but manual sealed-paper submissions are also permitted by mail, FedEx, UPS, or delivery to Procurement Services; fax and email submissions are not accepted. Required services include white-glove deployment with asset decaling, asset reporting, etching, and delivery to varied locations, with etching required on laptops only, Windows devices requiring autopilot, and Chromebooks requiring enrollment in Google Management. The term is a three-year agreement with two successive one-year extensions, not to exceed five years total, and the contract may use EPCNT or CTPA; delivery is starting in September 2024 per Addendum 1. Manufacturer authorization, warranty details, and other documentation requirements are not stated in the provided documents.

Product Specification.value:
Tier 1 Staff Windows Basic Desktop: Intel i5, 14th Gen or equivalent; minimum 16GB RAM; 512 GB NVMe SSD; minimum 23.8" diagonal touchscreen display; 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; Windows 11 Pro; 3-year minimum warranty.
Tier 2 Staff Professional Desktop: Intel i7, 14th Gen or equivalent; minimum 32GB DDR5 RAM; 1 TB NVMe SSD; minimum 23.8" diagonal display; 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; Windows 11 Pro or Mac O/S; 4 GB video card; 3-year minimum warranty. The document also says touchscreen is optional.
Tier 2 Large Student Chromebook Laptop: Intel Celeron Processor N100 or equivalent; minimum 8GB DDR5 Memory; 128 GB eMMC; minimum 14" diagonal non-touch display; 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; Chrome O/S License Required; 1-year minimum warranty.
Tier 1 Staff Basic Laptop: Intel i5 CPU, 14th Gen or equivalent; minimum 16GB DDR5 RAM; 512 GB NVMe SSD; minimum 13" diagonal display; 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; Windows 11 or Mac OS; 3-year minimum warranty.
Tier 2 Staff Laptop: Intel i7 CPU, 14th Gen or equivalent; minimum 32GB DDR5 RAM; 1 TB NVMe SSD; minimum 13" diagonal display; 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; Windows 11 or Mac OS; 3-year minimum warranty.
Tier 3 Student Windows Laptop: Intel i5 13th Gen or equivalent; minimum 16GB RAM DDR5 Memory; 256 GB NVMe SSD; minimum 13" diagonal, 1920-1080 non-touch display; 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; Windows 11 Pro; 3-year minimum warranty.
Student Tablet: Processor A13; 64 GB storage; 10.2" Retina display; 802.11AC and Bluetooth 4.2; iOS 17; 1-year minimum warranty. RAM is not specified in the cited tablet requirements.
